$comment: Non-secret runtime configuration. Safe to commit and to review in a diff.
Every secret lives in .env / GitHub Actions secrets - never here.
The workflow cron fires every 3 hours; this file decides whether a given
firing does real work, so the cadence changes without touching any YAML.

schedule.$comment: All hours are UTC. Steam flips prices at 10:00 America/Los_Angeles, i.e. 17:00 UTC in summer and 18:00 UTC in winter.

alerts.$comment: A deal qualifies when the current Steam price is at or below the historical Steam low. Comparisons run on integer minor units, never floats.

notification.$comment: Wording shown on the phone. Kept out of the source so it can be any language. The only placeholder is {count}.

state.$comment: Entries older than this are purged so the state file cannot grow without bound.
